questions.stem: Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=(2x^2-3x+3)\\{}\cdot (x+2)-2x\end{gathered}\]. Jeff claims \(f(x)=2x^3\) has only one positive root. Do you agree? Explain.
questions.stemZh: 設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=(2x^2-3x+3)\\{}\cdot (x+2)-2x\end{gathered}\]。Jeff 聲稱 \(f(x)=2x^3\) 只有一個正根。你是否同意？解釋。
questions.solution: Expansion gives \(f=2x^3+x^2-5x+6\). Thus \(f=2x^3\) is equivalent to \[\begin{gathered}x^2-5x+6\\{}=(x-2)(x-3)\\{}=0\end{gathered}\]. Both2 and 3 are positive; there are two distinct positive roots. Disagree.
questions.solutionZh: 展開得 \(f=2x^3+x^2-5x+6\)，故方程等同 \[\begin{gathered}x^2-5x+6\\{}=(x-2)(x-3)\\{}=0\end{gathered}\]。2及3均為正數，共有兩個相異正根，所以不同意。
questions.sourceZh: S4/more about polynomials/polynomials reviews.pdf · 第12題

questions.stem: The remainder when \(9x^3+kx^2-x+5\) is divided by \((3x+1)(3x-1)\) is3. Find \(k\).
questions.solution: At \(x=1/3\), the cubic and linear terms cancel, so \(k/9+5=3\). Hence \(k=-18\). Verify the division identity \[\begin{gathered}9x^3-18x^2-x+5\\{}=(9x^2-1)(x-2)+3\end{gathered}\], which also satisfies the other divisor root.
questions.solutionZh: 代入 \(x=1/3\)，三次項與一次項抵消，得 \(k/9+5=3\)，故 \(k=-18\)。檢查除法恆等式 \[\begin{gathered}9x^3-18x^2-x+5\\{}=(9x^2-1)(x-2)+3\end{gathered}\]，另一除式根亦符合。

(a) \(\frac3{x^2+x-2}-\frac5{x^2-x-6}\).

(b) \[\begin{gathered}\Bigl(\frac5{x^2-x-6}\\{}-\frac3{x^2+x-2}\Bigr)\\{}\div\frac{8x^2+12x-20}{2x^2-x-15}\end{gathered}\].
questions.solution:
(a) Factor the denominators as \((x+2)(x-1)\) and \((x+2)(x-3)\). The combined numerator is \[\begin{gathered}3(x-3)-5(x-1)\\{}=-2(x+2)\end{gathered}\]. Result \(-2/[(x-1)(x-3)]\), with \(x\ne-2,1,3\).

questions.stem:
Constants \(p,q\) satisfy \[\begin{gathered}\frac p{x-q}\\{}-\frac p{x-q+1}\\{}=\frac4{(x-q)(x-q+1)}\end{gathered}\].

(a) Find \(p\).

(b) Simplify \[\begin{gathered}\frac4{x(x+1)}\\{}+\frac4{(x+1)(x+2)}+\cdots\\{}+\frac4{(x+49)(x+50)}\end{gathered}\].
questions.stemZh:
常數 \(p,q\) 滿足 \[\begin{gathered}\frac p{x-q}\\{}-\frac p{x-q+1}\\{}=\frac4{(x-q)(x-q+1)}\end{gathered}\]。

(a) 求 \(p\)。

(b) 化簡 \[\begin{gathered}\frac4{x(x+1)}\\{}+\frac4{(x+1)(x+2)}+\cdots\\{}+\frac4{(x+49)(x+50)}\end{gathered}\]。
questions.solution:
(a) Clear denominators: \[\begin{gathered}p[(x-q+1)-(x-q)]\\{}=4\end{gathered}\], hence \(p=4\).

(b) Each summand is \(4/(x+i)-4/(x+i+1)\). Intermediate terms cancel, leaving \[\begin{gathered}4/x-4/(x+50)\\{}=200/[x(x+50)]\end{gathered}\]. Preserve original exclusions \(x\notin\{0,-1,\ldots,-50\}\).
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 同乘分母得 \[\begin{gathered}p[(x-q+1)-(x-q)]\\{}=4\end{gathered}\]，故 \(p=4\)。

(b) 每項為 \(4/(x+i)-4/(x+i+1)\)，中間項相消，餘下 \[\begin{gathered}4/x-4/(x+50)\\{}=200/[x(x+50)]\end{gathered}\]。保留原有限制 \(x\notin\{0,-1,\ldots,-50\}\)。

questions.stem:
Let \(p(x)\) be cubic and divisible by \(x^2-x-6\). Its remainders on division by \(x+1\) and \(x-2\) are 4 and \(-20\).

(a) Find \(p(x)\).

(b) Let \(q(x)=(x-3)(2x+k)\). Find the range of \(k\) for which \(p(x)=q(x)\) has three distinct real roots.
questions.stemZh:
設 \(p(x)\) 為三次多項式，可被 \(x^2-x-6\) 整除，被 \(x+1\) 及 \(x-2\) 除時餘式分別為4及 \(-20\)。

(a) 求 \(p(x)\)。

(b) 設 \(q(x)=(x-3)(2x+k)\)。求使 \(p(x)=q(x)\) 有三個相異實根的 \(k\) 值範圍。
questions.solution:
(a) Put \(p=(x^2-x-6)(ax+b)\). At \(-1,2\), \(-4(-a+b)=4\) and \(-4(2a+b)=-20\). Thus \(a-b=1,2a+b=5\), so \(a=2,b=1\). Hence \[\begin{gathered}p=(x-3)(x+2)\\{}\cdot (2x+1)\end{gathered}\].

(b) Subtract: \[\begin{gathered}p-q=(x-3)\\{}\cdot (2x^2+3x+2-k)\end{gathered}\]. The quadratic must have two distinct real roots: \(8k-7>0\). Neither may equal 3: its value at 3 is \(29-k\ne0\). Therefore \(k>7/8\) and \(k\ne29\).
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 設 \(p=(x^2-x-6)(ax+b)\)。代入 \(-1,2\) 得 \(-4(-a+b)=4\)、\(-4(2a+b)=-20\)。故 \(a-b=1,2a+b=5\)，解得 \(a=2,b=1\)。所以 \[\begin{gathered}p=(x-3)(x+2)\\{}\cdot (2x+1)\end{gathered}\]。

(b) 相減得 \[\begin{gathered}p-q=(x-3)\\{}\cdot (2x^2+3x+2-k)\end{gathered}\]。二次式須有兩個相異實根，所以 \(8k-7>0\)；亦不能包含根3，故 \(29-k\ne0\)。因此 \(k>7/8\) 且 \(k\ne29\)。

questions.stem: Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=(x^2+5x+m)\\{}\cdot (4x+3)+n\end{gathered}\]. The equation \(f(x)=n\) has exactly two distinct real roots. Find \(m\).
questions.stemZh: 設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=(x^2+5x+m)\\{}\cdot (4x+3)+n\end{gathered}\]。方程 \(f(x)=n\) 恰有兩個相異實根。求 \(m\)。
questions.solution:
The equation is \[\begin{gathered}(x^2+5x+m)\\{}\cdot (4x+3)\\{}=0\end{gathered}\], with fixed root \(-3/4\).

Case1: the quadratic has a repeated root: \(25-4m=0\), so \(m=25/4\). Its root \(-5/2\) differs from \(-3/4\), giving exactly two distinct roots.

Case2: the quadratic has two distinct roots, one equal to \(-3/4\). Substitution gives \(m=51/16\); the other root is \(-17/4\), different from \(-3/4\).

A negative discriminant gives only the fixed root. Thus the complete answer is \(m=25/4\) or \(51/16\).
questions.solutionZh:
方程為 \[\begin{gathered}(x^2+5x+m)\\{}\cdot (4x+3)\\{}=0\end{gathered}\]，固定根為 \(-3/4\)。

情況1：二次式有重根，\(25-4m=0\)，得 \(m=25/4\)。其根 \(-5/2\) 不等於 \(-3/4\)，恰有兩個相異根。

情況2：二次式有兩個相異根，其中一個為 \(-3/4\)。代入得 \(m=51/16\)，另一根為 \(-17/4\)，與固定根不同。

判別式負時只有固定根。因此完整答案為 \(m=25/4\) 或 \(51/16\)。

questions.stem: Let \(c\ne0\) and \(f(x)=x^3-3x+9\). The remainders on division by \(x-c\) and \(2x+c\) are equal. Find \(c\).
questions.solution: The divisor roots are \(c\) and \(-c/2\). Hence \[\begin{gathered}f(c)-f(-c/2)\\{}=9c(c^2-4)/8\\{}=0\end{gathered}\]. Reject \(c=0\) by the condition; the two remaining values are \(c=2,-2\).
questions.solutionZh: 除式的根為 \(c\) 及 \(-c/2\)，故 \[\begin{gathered}f(c)-f(-c/2)\\{}=9c(c^2-4)/8\\{}=0\end{gathered}\]。由條件排除 \(c=0\)，餘下 \(c=2,-2\)。

Let \(f(x)=x^{2046}\).

(a) Find the remainder when \(f(x-1)\) is divided by \(x\).

(b) Find the remainder when the integer \(8^{2046}\) is divided by9.
questions.solution:
(a) Set \(x=0\): \(f(-1)=(-1)^{2046}=1\).

(b) The polynomial \(t^{2046}-1\) vanishes at \(t=-1\), so it has integer-coefficient factor \(t+1\). At \(t=8\), \(8^{2046}-1\) is divisible by9. Since \(0\le1<9\), the integer remainder is1.

questions.stem: \(4x^3+mx+n\) is divisible by \(2x^2+x-6\). Find \(m,n\).
questions.solution: The leading quotient term is \(2x\). To cancel the quadratic coefficient, the quotient must be \(2x-1\). Expanding gives \[\begin{gathered}(2x^2+x-6)(2x-1)\\{}=4x^3-13x+6\end{gathered}\], so \(m=-13,n=6\), simultaneously.
questions.solutionZh: 商式最高次項為 \(2x\)；要消去二次項，商式必為 \(2x-1\)。展開得 \[\begin{gathered}(2x^2+x-6)(2x-1)\\{}=4x^3-13x+6\end{gathered}\]，所以同時有 \(m=-13,n=6\)。

questions.stem:
Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=x^3\\{}+kx^2-24x-28\end{gathered}\]. It is given that \(f(x)=Q(x)(x+2)^2\).

(a) Find \(k\).

(b) Find \(Q(x)\).
questions.solution:
(a) \[\begin{gathered}f(-2)=-8+4k+48\\{}-28=0\end{gathered}\], so \(k=-3\).

(b) The leading coefficient forces \(Q=x+c\), and the constant term gives \(4c=-28\), so \(c=-7\). Verify \[\begin{gathered}(x-7)(x+2)^2\\{}=x^3-3x^2-24x-28\end{gathered}\]. Thus \(Q=x-7\).
questions.solutionZh:
(a) \[\begin{gathered}f(-2)=-8+4k+48\\{}-28=0\end{gathered}\]，故 \(k=-3\)。

(b) 由最高次項知 \(Q=x+c\)，常數項給 \(4c=-28\)，故 \(c=-7\)。檢查 \[\begin{gathered}(x-7)(x+2)^2\\{}=x^3-3x^2-24x-28\end{gathered}\]，所以 \(Q=x-7\)。

questions.stem:
\(3x^2+7x+a\) is the H.C.F. of \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=3x^3\\{}-5x^2-26x-8\end{gathered}\] and \[\begin{gathered}g(x)=(x-3)\\{}\cdot (3x^2+7x+a)\end{gathered}\].

(a) Find \(a\).

(b) Find their L.C.M.
questions.stemZh:
\(3x^2+7x+a\) 是 \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=3x^3\\{}-5x^2-26x-8\end{gathered}\] 及 \[\begin{gathered}g(x)=(x-3)\\{}\cdot (3x^2+7x+a)\end{gathered}\] 的最大公因式。

(a) 求 \(a\)。

(b) 求它們的最小公倍式。
questions.solution:
(a) Dividing \(f\) by \(3x^2+7x+a\) forces quotient \(x-4\). Comparing the linear coefficient gives \(a-28=-26\), so \(a=2\); the constant \(-4a=-8\) confirms it.

(b) \[\begin{gathered}f=(x-4)\\{}\cdot (3x+1)(x+2)\end{gathered}\] and \[\begin{gathered}g=(x-3)\\{}\cdot (3x+1)(x+2)\end{gathered}\]. Thus LCM \[\begin{gathered}(x-4)(3x+1)(x+2)\\{}\cdot (x-3)\end{gathered}\].
questions.solutionZh:
(a) \(f\) 除以 \(3x^2+7x+a\) 的商式必為 \(x-4\)，比較一次項得 \(a-28=-26\)，故 \(a=2\)；常數項 \(-4a=-8\) 亦符合。

(b) \[\begin{gathered}f=(x-4)\\{}\cdot (3x+1)(x+2)\end{gathered}\]、\[\begin{gathered}g=(x-3)\\{}\cdot (3x+1)(x+2)\end{gathered}\]，故最小公倍式為 \[\begin{gathered}(x-4)(3x+1)(x+2)\\{}\cdot (x-3)\end{gathered}\]。

questions.stem:
\[\begin{gathered}f(x)=6x^3\\{}+5x^2+ax-4\end{gathered}\] has remainder \(-3\) on division by \(2x-1\). Also \[\begin{gathered}g(x)=(bx-1)\\{}\cdot (9x^2-3x-2)\end{gathered}\] is divisible by \(2x-1\).

(a) Find \(a,b\).

(b) Factorise \(f(x)+3\).

(c) Find the L.C.M. of \(f(x)+3\) and \(g(x)\).
questions.stemZh:
\[\begin{gathered}f(x)=6x^3\\{}+5x^2+ax-4\end{gathered}\] 被 \(2x-1\) 除時餘式為 \(-3\)，而 \[\begin{gathered}g(x)=(bx-1)\\{}\cdot (9x^2-3x-2)\end{gathered}\] 可被 \(2x-1\) 整除。

(a) 求 \(a,b\)。

(b) 因式分解 \(f(x)+3\)。

(c) 求 \(f(x)+3\) 與 \(g(x)\) 的最小公倍式。
questions.solution:
(a) \(f(1/2)=a/2-2=-3\) gives \(a=-2\). At \(1/2\), \(g=(b/2-1)(-5/4)=0\), so \(b=2\).

(b) \[\begin{gathered}f+3=(3x+1)(x+1)\\{}\cdot (2x-1)\end{gathered}\].

(c) \[\begin{gathered}g=(2x-1)(3x+1)\\{}\cdot (3x-2)\end{gathered}\]. The LCM is \[\begin{gathered}(3x+1)(x+1)\\{}\cdot (2x-1)(3x-2)\end{gathered}\].
questions.solutionZh:
(a) \(f(1/2)=a/2-2=-3\)，得 \(a=-2\)。又 \[\begin{gathered}g(1/2)=(b/2-1)\\{}\cdot (-5/4)\\{}=0\end{gathered}\]，故 \(b=2\)。

(b) \[\begin{gathered}f+3=(3x+1)(x+1)\\{}\cdot (2x-1)\end{gathered}\]。

(c) \[\begin{gathered}g=(2x-1)(3x+1)\\{}\cdot (3x-2)\end{gathered}\]，最小公倍式為 \[\begin{gathered}(3x+1)(x+1)\\{}\cdot (2x-1)(3x-2)\end{gathered}\]。

questions.stem: Simplify \(\left(\frac2{x+3}+\frac1{x-1}\right)\frac{x^2+3x-4}{3x+1}\).
questions.solution: The bracket is \((3x+1)/[(x+3)(x-1)]\). Factor \[\begin{gathered}x^2+3x-4\\{}=(x+4)(x-1)\end{gathered}\] and cancel to obtain \((x+4)/(x+3)\). Retain \(x\ne-3,1,-1/3\).

questions.stem: Constants \(A,B,C\) satisfy \[\begin{gathered}\frac A{125x^3-1}\equiv\frac{1/3}{5x-1}\\{}+\frac{Bx+C}{25x^2+5x+1}\end{gathered}\]. Find \(A,B,C\).
questions.solution: Clear denominators: \[\begin{gathered}A=(25x^2+5x+1)/3\\{}+(Bx+C)(5x-1)\end{gathered}\]. Compare \(x^2\): \(25/3+5B=0\), hence \(B=-5/3\). Compare \(x\): \(5/3-B+5C=0\), hence \(C=-2/3\). Constants give \(A=1/3-C=1\). The original real domain excludes \(x=1/5\).
questions.solutionZh: 同乘分母得 \[\begin{gathered}A=(25x^2+5x+1)/3\\{}+(Bx+C)(5x-1)\end{gathered}\]。比較二次項得 \(25/3+5B=0\)，故 \(B=-5/3\)；比較一次項得 \(5/3-B+5C=0\)，故 \(C=-2/3\)。常數項給 \(A=1/3-C=1\)。原式實數定義域排除 \(x=1/5\)。

questions.stem:
Constants \(m,n\) satisfy \[\begin{gathered}\frac m{2x+n}\\{}-\frac m{2x+n+2}\\{}=\frac8{(2x+n)(2x+n+2)}\end{gathered}\].

(a) Find \(m\).

(b) Simplify \[\begin{gathered}\frac8{(2x+1)(2x+3)}\\{}+\frac8{(2x+3)(2x+5)}\\{}+\frac8{(2x+5)(2x+7)}\\{}+\frac8{(2x+7)(2x+9)}\end{gathered}\].
questions.stemZh:
常數 \(m,n\) 滿足 \[\begin{gathered}\frac m{2x+n}\\{}-\frac m{2x+n+2}\\{}=\frac8{(2x+n)(2x+n+2)}\end{gathered}\]。

(a) 求 \(m\)。

(b) 化簡 \[\begin{gathered}\frac8{(2x+1)(2x+3)}\\{}+\frac8{(2x+3)(2x+5)}\\{}+\frac8{(2x+5)(2x+7)}\\{}+\frac8{(2x+7)(2x+9)}\end{gathered}\]。
questions.solution:
(a) Clearing denominators gives \(2m=8\), so \(m=4\).

(b) Each summand equals \[\begin{gathered}4/(2x+j)\\{}-4/(2x+j+2)\end{gathered}\]. Telescoping leaves \[\begin{gathered}4/(2x+1)\\{}-4/(2x+9)\\{}=32/[(2x+1)(2x+9)]\end{gathered}\]. Keep \[\begin{gathered}x\ne-1/2,-3/2,-5/2,\\{}-7/2,-9/2\end{gathered}\].
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 同乘分母得 \(2m=8\)，故 \(m=4\)。

(b) 每項為 \[\begin{gathered}4/(2x+j)\\{}-4/(2x+j+2)\end{gathered}\]，中間項相消後餘下 \[\begin{gathered}4/(2x+1)\\{}-4/(2x+9)\\{}=32/[(2x+1)(2x+9)]\end{gathered}\]。保留 \[\begin{gathered}x\ne-1/2,-3/2,-5/2,\\{}-7/2,-9/2\end{gathered}\]。

questions.stem:
(a) Find the LCM of \(a^2-1\) and \(a^2-2a-3\).

(b) Hence simplify \[\frac1{a^2-1}-\frac2{a^2-2a-3}\].
questions.solution:
(a) The factors are \((a+1)(a-1)\) and \((a+1)(a-3)\). Their LCM is \((a+1)(a-1)(a-3)\).

(b) The combined numerator is \[\begin{gathered}(a-3)-2(a-1)\\{}=-(a+1)\end{gathered}\]. Cancelling gives \(-1/[(a-1)(a-3)]\), where \(a\) excludes −1, 1 and 3.
